name: The Witchfinder
text: Deploy: Spawn 3 Syndicate Crowns on this row. At the end of your turn, if no enemy unit has a Bounty, place a Bounty on the highest-power enemy unit.

name: Fabian Hale
text: Intimidate. Deploy: Place a Bounty on an enemy unit. If there already was an enemy unit with a Bounty, gain Coins equal to its base power.

name: Hysteria
text: Place a Bounty on an enemy unit and damage it by 3. If it already has a Bounty, damage by 6 instead.

name: Vigilantes
text: Whenever a Bounty is placed on an enemy unit, damage it by 2.

name: Teleportation
text: Reset an allied unit's power. If it's a bronze unit, replay it instead.

name: Megascope
text: Deploy: Choose a bronze allied unit. Timer 2: Spawn a base copy of chosen unit to the right of Megascope.

name: Artaud Terranova
text: Assimilate. Deploy: Spawn and play a base copy of any non-Disloyal unit you gave Spying to during this game, excluding self.

name: Sunset Wanderers
text: This card starts in the leftmost position of your hand. At the start of your turn, while in hand, move self one position to the right, then boost self by 1. At the end of your turn, if you haven't passed and there are no cards to the right of this card, Summon self from your hand to a random allied row, then draw a card.

name: Fercart
text: Deploy: Play a special card from your hand, then draw a card. Whenever you play a special card, give Spying to a random non-Spying enemy unit.

name: Master of Puppets
text: Order: Seize a bronze enemy unit, then move self to the opposite row. Cooldown: 2

name: Thanedd Turncoat
text: Deploy: Give an enemy unit Spying. Order (Conspiracy): Damage an enemy unit by 1. Whenever an enemy unit gains Spying, reduce the Cooldown by 1. Cooldown: 2

name: Melusine
text: Deploy: Gain Veil. Order: Spawn Rain on an enemy row for 2 turns, then damage self by 2. At the end of your turn, damage adjacent units by 1, then gain 1 base power for each unit damaged. If any unit damaged was a Cultist, refresh this Order.

name: Offering to the Sea
text: Damage all units on the battlefield by 1, then Spawn a Deafening Siren on a random allied row and boost it by the number of allied targets.

name: Havfrue Singer
text: Deploy: Heal an allied unit by 2. The first time you Heal an allied unit during your turn, Spawn a Deafening Siren on this row.

name: Hermit
text: Deploy: Damage self by 4. Berserk 6: At the end of your turn, damage the unit to the right by 1, then Heal self by 2.

name: Simlas Finn aep Dabairr
text: Deploy: Play all copies of a bronze special card from your deck.

name: Saov Ainmhi'dh
text: Boost an allied unit by 5. When this card enters your graveyard, transform self into Saov Ainmhi'dh: Unity.

name: Orb of Insight
text: Boost an allied unit by 2 and give it Vitality (2). While in your graveyard, lower the Counter by 1 whenever you play a special card. When the Counter reaches 0, play this card and give it Doomed. Counter: 3

name: Elven Seer
text: When you target this unit with a bronze special card, Spawn and play a copy of that special card. Counter: 1

name: Tissaia de Vries
text: Deploy: At the end of this turn, reset the Order of all allied Mages that used their Order during this turn.

name: Leticia Charbonneau
text: Patience. Order (Ranged): At the end of this turn, the Patience value of allied units is increased by [1] instead.

name: Practice Makes Perfect
text: Shuffle an allied bronze Mage back into your deck, then play a random bronze Mage from your deck and boost it by 0. Increase the boost by 1 for each unit with Patience you played this game.

name: Aretuza Student
text: Patience (Ranged). Order (Ranged): Boost an allied unit by [0].

name: Bloody Mistress
text: Sabbath: At the end of your turn, Spawn a Gernichora's Fruit on each sides of this unit and transform self into Gernichora without changing power.

name: Mammuna
text: Zeal. Order: Banish a bronze unit from your graveyard and boost self by its power, then Summon a copy of it from your deck to this row. Sabbath: Play the copy instead.

name: Selfeater
text: Order: Halve this unit's base power, then Spawn a copy with the same base power on this row. Whenever you play a Relict, increase this unit's base power by 1.

name: Bleeding Effigy
text: Banish a bronze unit from your opponent's graveyard, then boost an allied unit by its power. If you control Bloody Mistress or Gernichora, you may also target gold units.

name: The Scoundrel
text: Deploy: Summon the top bronze unit from your opponent's deck to the opposite row, then place a Bounty on it. Tribute 2: Choose a bronze unit to Summon instead, then place a Bounty on it. Fee 1: Damage the enemy unit with a Bounty by 1.

name: Ignatius Hale
text: At the start of the game, or when Spawned, set own power to 1. While in hand, deck, or on the battlefield, whenever an enemy unit with a Bounty is destroyed, Heal self by its base power.

name: Confession Extractor
text: Profit 4. While in your graveyard, damage an enemy unit by 1 whenever you place a Bounty on it. Counter: 3

name: Scapegoat
text: Disloyal. Profit 7. Deploy: Place a Bounty on self.

name: Bearification
text: Transform an artifact into an Elder Bear. If it's on your side of the battlefield, also boost it by 4.

name: Dwimveandra
text: Deploy (Melee): Set an allied Scenario to the final chapter. Deploy (Ranged): Refresh the Order of an allied Location.

name: Vilgefortz: Renegade
text: Deploy: Swap a card from your opponent's graveyard with a card in your hand.

name: Lydia van Bredevoort
text: Deploy (Melee): Create and play a bronze special card from your opponent's faction. Deploy (Ranged): Play a bronze special card from your opponent's graveyard.

name: Imperial Practitioner
text: Assimilate. Order: Spawn a base copy of the last card that went to your opponent's graveyard on top of your deck.

name: Illusionist
text: Deploy: Spawn a base copy of a bronze unit from your opponent's graveyard to the right of self and set its power to 1. Bonded: Don't set its power to 1.

name: Fucusya
text: Deploy: Play a non-Neutral unit from your graveyard with a provision cost of 10 or less and give it Doomed, then Spawn Rain on the opposite row with a duration equal to unused provisions.

name: Rioghan the Undying
text: This card starts in your graveyard. When played or Summoned from the graveyard, trigger all remaining Rain and Storm on your opponent's side of the battlefield.

name: Messenger of the Sea
text: Whenever Rain or Storm damages enemy units, boost self by the damage dealt.

name: Little Havfrue
text: Deploy (Bonded): Increase this unit's base power by 2. Order: Damage self by 4 and Spawn Rain on an enemy row for 2 turns.

name: Filavandrel aén Fidháil
text: Deploy (Melee): Create and play a Scoia'tael special card with a provision cost equal to this unit's power. Deploy (Ranged): Create and play a Scoia'tael special card with a provision cost equal to or lower than this unit's power.

name: Torque
text: This card starts in your hand. Whenever this card is boosted in your hand, boost a random different unit in your hand by the same amount.

name: Bountiful Harvest
text: Create and play a bronze Scoia'tael Elf, then, depending on the position of the chosen unit, boost the leftmost, a random, or the rightmost unit in your hand by 2.

name: Watcher of the Valley
text: Deploy: Give an enemy unit Bleeding equal to the amount of boost on this card. Bonded: Damage it by that amount instead.

name: Chapter of Wizards
text: Resilience. Deploy: Spawn and play Runeword. Order: Spawn on this row a base copy of the last bronze allied Mage you played.

name: Raffard’s Vengeance
text: Order: Play a bronze unit from your hand, then draw a card. Cooldown: 5 Crew: Whenever you play a unit next to this card, damage a random enemy unit by 2. Mages contribute to this card's Crew ability.

name: Alumni
text: Deploy: If the damage and boost values are equal to, or higher than 4, gain Zeal. Order (Melee): Damage an enemy unit by 0. Order (Ranged): Boost an allied unit by 0. The damage and boost values correspond to the highest Patience achieved by your Ban Ard Students or Aretuza Students this game, respectively.

name: Meditating Mage
text: Patience. Order: Gain Vitality [0]. Bonded: Also gain Resilience.

name: Yaga
text: Deploy (Sabbath): Gain Zeal. Order: Consume a 4-provision cost unit, then increase the provision value by 1. Cooldown: 2

name: Witches' Sabbath
text: Summon up to 3 highest-power units from your opponent's graveyard to an enemy row, then Summon as many highest-power non-Neutral units from your graveyard to the opposite row and give them Doomed.

name: Incubus
text: Deploy: Summon a bronze unit from your opponent's graveyard to the opposite row, then Summon a bronze unit of equal or less provisions from your graveyard to this row.

name: Lesser Witch
text: Deploy: Spawn a base copy of self in your graveyard. Bonded: Spawn a base copy of self on this row instead.

name: The Brute
text: Profit 0. Deploy: Boost self by boost. The boost is equal to the base power of the highest-power enemy unit with a Bounty you destroyed this game. Whenever you place a Bounty on an enemy unit, increase the Profit by 1.

name: Octavia Hale
text: Deploy: Draw up to 2 of Octavia's sons, then shuffle the same number of number of cards back into your deck. Fee 2: Boost an allied Witch Hunter by 2. If you destroyed an enemy unit this turn, boost by 3 instead.

name: Purge
text: Damage an enemy unit by 3. Increase the damage by 1 for each Witch Hunter you control. Deathblow: Place a Bounty on the highest-power enemy unit.

name: Savvy Huckster
text: Profit 1. Deploy: Damage an enemy unit by 1. Fee 1: Gain Vitality (1). Bonded: Increase the Profit and damage by 1.

name: The Mushy Truffle
text: Resilience. Deploy: Spawn and play a Bonded unit from your starting deck. Order: Spawn and play Golden Froth.

name: Alissa Henson
text: Deploy: Shuffle a special card from your graveyard into your deck. If it was a bronze, also shuffle one additional copy of that special.

name: The Eternal Eclipse
text: Doomed. Scenario: Progress whenever you play a gold Cultist. Prologue: Spawn Eternal Eclipse Initiate on this row. Chapter 1: Infuse all your non-Disloyal Cultists on the battlefield, in your hand and in your deck with "Whenever you play a Cultist, boost self by 1, then increase this value by 1 if it was a bronze". Chapter 2: Spawn and play Eternal Eclipse Deacon.

name: Master of Ceremonies
text: At the start of the game, Infuse 2 random gold non-Cultist units in your starting deck with Cultist category and Infuse them with "After this card is played or Summoned, if you control 3 or more Cultists, damage the lowest-power Infused enemy unit by 3".

name: Eternal Eclipse Deacon
text: Deploy: Infuse a unit in your hand with the Cultist category. Order: Infuse a unit in your deck with the Cultist category.

name: Eternal Eclipse Initiate
text: Order: Infuse a bronze enemy unit with "Whenever your opponent plays a Cultist, damage self by 1. Deathwish: Spawn a base copy of self on the opposite row, Infuse it with the Cultist category, then set its power to the number of Cultists your opponent controls".

name: Endless Voyage
text: Doomed. Scenario: Progress whenever you play a Pirate. Prologue: Spawn Bjorn's Drakkar on this row. Chapter 1: Whenever your opponent plays a unit, Infuse it with "Deathwish: Spawn Cataclysm on this row for 1 turn". Chapter 2: Purify and Heal an allied Bjorn's Drakkar, increase its base power by 5 and give it 1 Charge. If you don't control Bjorn's Drakkar, Spawn it on this row instead.

name: Bjorn Stormursson
text: Veteran. Deploy: Clash with an enemy unit. Order (Bloodthirst 2): Discard a card, then move self back to your hand.

name: Deranged Corsair
text: Deploy: Infuse an enemy unit with "Deathwish: Spawn Cataclysm on this row for 2 turns", then Spawn Cataclysm on its row for 1 turn.

name: Seagull
text: Deploy: Damage 3 units by 1, then Spawn a Seagull in your graveyard for each target that is damaged or destroyed. When an enemy unit is destroyed, Summon self from your graveyard to your Ranged row, then gain Doomed.

name: Mysteries of Loc Feainn
text: Doomed. Scenario: Progress whenever you play a unit with Harmony. Prologue: Spawn Lake Guardian: Dawn Aspect on this row and set its power to the number of non-Neutral units with unique primary categories in your starting deck. Chapter 1: Whenever you play a non-Neutral unit, boost it by 1 for each category it has. Chapter 2: Spawn and play Loc Feainn: Convergence.

name: Lake Guardian: Dusk Aspect
text: Harmony. This unit's Harmony is also triggered in hand and deck.

name: Antherion
text: Harmony. Order: Infuse an allied unit with "Harmony".

name: Chameleon
text: Deploy: Infuse self with a random Scoia'tael primary category that you don't control. Order: Replay self, then reduce own base power by 1.

name: Damsel in Distress
text: Doomed. Scenario: Progress whenever you play a Knight. Prologue: Summon a bronze Knight from your deck to this row. Chapter 1: Whenever an allied unit triggers Grace, boost its adjacent units by 2. Chapter 2: Spawn and play Mad Charge.

name: The Maiden's Shield
text: Shield. Grace 8: Spawn Bronwen the Bold to the right of self. Grace 14: Boost the allied Bronwen the Bold by 3. Deathwish: Lock the allied Bronwen the Bold.

name: Knight-Errant
text: At the end of your turn, boost self by 1 for each adjacent boosted unit and damage self by 1 for each adjacent damaged unit. Grace 9: Give adjacent units Shield, then Infuse them with "Whenever this unit loses Shield, boost it by 2".

name: Squire
text: Order: Boost the next unit you play by 2. If it is a Knight, also Infuse it with "At the end of your turn, boost self by 1".

name: The Manor’s Dark Secret
text: Doomed. Scenario: Progress whenever you play a unit with Thrive. Prologue: Spawn a Cursed Damsel on this row and boost it by 2. Chapter 1: Whenever you play a unit, if it would not trigger any of your Thrive units, boost it by 2 first. Chapter 2: Play the highest-power bronze non-Neutral unit from your deck.

name: Sir Scratch-a-Lot
text: At the start of the game, gain Immunity. Deploy: Boost self by 0. Order: Increase the boost value by 2, then replay self. Units played on your opponent's side can trigger your Thrive abilities.

name: Cursed Damsel
text: Thrive. Order: Halve own power and destroy an enemy unit with power up to the power removed from self.

name: Orchard Mantrap
text: Deploy (Melee): Consume an allied unit. This unit triggers Thrive an additional time. Deploy (Ranged): Infuse 2 allied units with "Thrive".

name: In Search of Forgotten Treasures
text: Doomed. Scenario: Progress whenever you play a Tidecloak. Prologue: Spawn Gudrun Bjornsdottir on this row. Chapter 1: Hoard 8: At the end of your turn, gain enough Coins to fill your pouch. Chapter 2: Damage the highest-power enemy unit by the number of Coins you have.

name: Flyndr's Crew
text: Deploy: Spawn 3 base copies of self on this row. Reduce the number of copies by 1 for each Counter. Your Hoards require 1 less Coins to trigger. Hoard 9: Once per round, at the end of your turn, while in hand or deck, remove a Counter. Counter: 3

name: Treasure Huntress
text: Profit 3. Fee 3 (Hoard 9): Infuse an allied unit with "At the end of your turn, gain 1 Coin".

name: Pearl Diver
text: Timer 3: Gain 6 Coins.

name: Renfri
text: Doomed. Deploy: If your starting deck has at least 25 units, Create a curse to replace your leader ability, then Create a blessing and Infuse your leader ability with it.

name: Renfri's Gang
text: Deploy: If your starting deck has at least 25 units, Summon all copies of self from your deck to this row.

name: Saskia: Commander
text: Immunity. Deploy: If you have at least 10 different primary categories in your starting deck, Summon a random bronze non-Neutral unit with a primary category that is not on your side of the battlefield from your deck to this row. Timer 3: Repeat the Deploy ability and reset the Timer.

name: King Radovid V
text: Deploy: If the base version of your leader ability has more than 1 Charge, give it an additional Charge. Order: Repeat the Deploy ability.

name: Jan Calveit
text: Deploy: Sort the cards in your deck from the highest to the lowest provision cost. At the start of the game, move self up by one position in the deck for each Tactic in your starting deck.

name: Arachas Queen
text: Deploy: Consume an allied unit. Order: Spawn and play Arachas Nest. Deathwish: Spawn a base copy of the Consumed unit on this row.

name: Ardal aep Dahy
text: Deploy (Ranged): If neither player has passed and your opponent's hand is not full, move a non-Doomed enemy unit with power up to 2 to your opponent's hand, then draw a card. Increase the maximum value by the number of Tactics in your starting deck.

name: King Bran
text: Veteran. Deploy: Boost self by 0. Increase the value by 1 whenever excess damage is dealt to enemy units. At the start of the game, trigger the Veteran ability of your units.

name: Cerys: Fearless
text: After you've dealt damage to allied units 9 times, Summon self from your deck to your Ranged row. Zeal. Order: Heal an allied unit and damage another allied unit by the amount Healed. Cooldown: 1

name: Milva: Sharpshooter
text: Zeal. Order: Damage an enemy unit by 1. Deathblow: Shuffle self back into your deck. Whenever an enemy unit moves during your turn, Summon self from your deck to the opposite row, then damage it by 1.

name: King Henselt
text: Deploy: Play a Crew unit from your deck. Whenever an adjacent unit's Cooldown decreases, boost self by the same amount.

name: Regis: Reborn
text: Deploy: Drain an enemy unit by 3. At the end of your turn, while in hand or deck, if there is an enemy unit with Bleeding, increase own base power by 1.

name: King of Beggars
text: Fee 1: Boost self by 1. While in deck, whenever you pay a Tribute, remove a Counter for each Coin spent. For each removed Counter, gain 1 Coin. When the Counter reaches 0, Summon self from your deck to a random allied row. Counter: 12

name: Cyrus Engelkind Hemmelfart
text: Profit 4. Deploy: Spawn and play Congregation. Fee 2: Destroy an allied Firesworn Token, then Summon a bronze Firesworn unit from your graveyard to the same position. Cooldown: 1

name: Aerondight
text: Echo. Damage an enemy unit by 0, then boost the lowest-power allied unit by the excess damage dealt. At the end of your turn, if you have more points than your opponent, increase the damage by 1, wherever this card is.

name: Arcane Tome
text: Zeal. Order: Play a special card from your deck, then move self to the opposite row. If there is no space on the opposite row, destroy self. Cooldown: 1 At the end of your turn, if not on Cooldown, destroy self.

name: Mysterious Puzzle Box
text: Disloyal. Deploy: Spawn a 7-power Lamp Djinn on the opposite row. If neither player has passed, choose a card from your hand. Adrenaline 2: Spawn a 7-power Lamp Djinn on the opposite row and destroy self instead. Order: Pick a card from your hand. At the end of your turn, transform the highest-provision chosen card(s) in hand into Thing From the Box, then Banish self.

name: Vial of Forbidden Knowledge
text: Zeal. Order: Boost an allied unit by 4 and give it Vitality (4). At the start of the game, if both players have this card in their deck, Summon self to a random allied row and transform.

name: Ring of Favor
text: This card starts in your hand. Boost an allied unit by 3. While in hand, at the end of your turn, increase the boost by 2. When your opponent passes, Banish self from hand and draw a card. When moved to the deck, Banish self.

name: Ornate Censer
text: Boost an allied unit by the amount of damage dealt to enemy units this turn, or damage an enemy unit by the amount of boost given to allied units this turn.

name: Troll Porter
text: Deploy (Melee): Banish all cards in your hand, then draw as many cards.

name: Runemage
text: Deploy: For the rest of the game, your Create effects show you 5 options instead of 3. Create and play a Runestone.

name: Obsidian Mirror
text: Spawn 1-power copies of 3 enemy bronze units on their opposite row.

name: Prophet
text: Deploy: Damage self by 2, then Lock all units in your opponent's hand until the end of round. The next time your opponent plays a Locked unit, remove Lock from all units in your opponent's hand. Adrenaline 2: Lock self instead.

name: Magic Compass
text: Echo. Look at the top 3 cards in your deck. Play one, then move the rest to your graveyard. If there are fewer than 3 cards in your deck, Spawn and play a legendary card from your faction that was not in your starting deck instead.

name: Highland Warlord
text: Veteran. Deploy: Increase the damage of your Raid cards by 1 for the rest of the game.

name: Prism Pendant
text: Whenever you target an allied unit with a special, give it Vitality equal to the special's provision cost. Whenever you target an enemy unit with a special, give it Bleeding equal to the special's provision cost.

name: Giantslayer
text: Deploy: Choose an enemy unit. If its base power is higher than self's, gain 3 Armor. Barricade: At the end of your turn, damage chosen unit by 1. Deathblow: Gain Resilience.

name: Mutagenerator
text: Whenever you play a unit on your Melee row, boost 5 random units on your side of battlefield with the same provision cost by 1. Whenever you play a unit on your Ranged row, boost 5 random units in your deck with the same provision cost by 1.

name: Traveling Priestess
text: Veil. Deploy: Gain 1 Charges. Whenever this unit is moved back into your deck, increase the number of Charges by 2. Order: Boost an allied unit by 1. Whenever this unit is Inspired, gain Zeal. Charge: 0

name: Necromancer's Tome
text: Zeal. Order: Trigger a bronze allied unit's Deathwish ability. Whenever you play a bronze unit, Summon a random copy of it from your graveyard to the same row and give it Doomed.

name: Giant Toad
text: Deploy: Consume an allied unit. When you play a Deathwish unit on your Ranged row, Summon self from your graveyard to the same row, Consume it and gain Doomed.

name: Conjurer's Candle
text: Resilience. Profit 4. Fee 1: Boost an allied unit by 1. Increase the boost by this card's Fee cost. Each time you pay this card's Fee, increase its cost by 1, up to 9.

name: Shady Vendor
text: Profit 1. Tribute 4 (Melee): Create and play a bronze 4-provision Crime. Tribute 5 (Ranged): Create and play a bronze 5-provision Crime.

name: Golden Nekker
text: Deploy: If your starting deck does not have cards with a provision cost of 10 or more, play the top unit, special, and artifact from your deck. Ciri: Nova and Golden Nekker are excluded from this condition.

name: Beauclair
text: Resilience. Deploy: Set an allied unit's power to match the highest-power enemy unit. Order: Reset the power of a unit.

name: Guillaume de Launfal
text: Deploy: Boost self by the number of allied Knights on this row, then boost self and an enemy unit by half of both units' power. Order (Grace 14): Move all statuses from an enemy unit to self.

name: Buhurt
text: Boost an enemy unit by 3, then an allied unit by 9.

name: Knight Challenger
text: Deploy: Gain Vitality equal to the amount of boost an enemy unit has. Grace 8: Boost all units by 1.
